text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part B, students fill a Percy says / I infer / I predict chart with quotes and page numbers, which has them cite textual evidence to support inferences."},{"code":"RL.6.2","verdict":"partly","reason":"Part B has students state a tentative theme from details and separate it from opinion, but no activity has students summarize the text, which the standard also requires."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"The Literacy Lab uses word parts (mort-, im-, -ology, trans-) to work out immortal and mortal, and Part A has students confirm expelled, probation and frayed in context."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The read aloud in Part A and the Part B and C activities use The Lightning Thief, Chapter 1, pp. 1–8, with stops and quotes drawn from those pages."}}
